issues.summary: Syntax error: Unexpected 'catch' - missing closing brace in if-else structure
issues.evidence: Build error: 'Unexpected catch' at line 467. TypeScript error: 'try' expected at line 467.
issues.root_cause: Missing closing brace for if block containing try-catch, causing parser to misinterpret the catch statement

fix.strategy: Fix brace structure: ensure if block at line 361 properly closes before else if at line 433. The try-catch block needs proper indentation and the if block needs to close correctly.
fix.patch_example: Fix indentation and brace structure around lines 361-433

issues.evidence: Build error: 'Cannot assign to remainingBudget because it is a constant' at line 177
issues.root_cause: Variable declared as const but later modified with -= operator

fix.strategy: Change const to let for remainingBudget variable
fix.patch_example: Change 'const remainingBudget' to 'let remainingBudget' at line 168

issues.summary: Workspace protocol 'workspace:*' not supported by npm
issues.evidence: npm install fails with 'Unsupported URL Type workspace:'
issues.root_cause: npm workspaces don't support 'workspace:*' protocol (pnpm/yarn feature)

fix.strategy: Replace 'workspace:*' with '*' for npm workspaces compatibility

issues.summary: Peer dependency conflict: React 19 vs lucide-react supporting only React 16-18
issues.evidence: npm install requires --legacy-peer-deps flag. lucide-react@0.344.0 only supports '^16.5.1 || ^17.0.0 || ^18.0.0'
issues.root_cause: Examples use React 19 but lucide-react doesn't support it yet

fix.strategy: Either downgrade React to 18.x in examples or upgrade lucide-react to a version supporting React 19, or use --legacy-peer-deps in CI
fix.patch_example: Update lucide-react to ^0.400.0+ if available, or pin React to ^18.0.0

issues.evidence: npm audit reports vulnerabilities after install
issues.root_cause: Outdated dependencies with known security issues

fix.strategy: Run npm audit fix and review critical vulnerability, update affected packages
fix.patch_example: npm audit fix (with review of breaking changes)

issues.evidence: Warnings for rimraf@2.6.3, glob@7.2.3, eslint@8.57.1, etc.

fix.strategy: Update direct dependencies to versions that don't pull in deprecated packages
fix.patch_example: Update eslint and other packages to latest versions
